stages.name: refraction
stages.outcome: Supported shared surface and exact original footprint; raw paired baseline saved. No geometry parameter fit or visible-fidelity acceptance. Frost/response remain unisolated.

stages.name: blurriness
parameters_frozen: Same geometry, cache/source XY, AA2, original source/case/masks/foreground/artwork, unit response and shadow0
stages.checkpoint: Validate finite source kernel/bilinear support and output padding before candidate RGB. Exact zero replay through original foreground chain.
stages.stop: Stop a proposal at unsupported source, failed zero control, budget or deadline. Independent declared operator may still be reported.
stages.outcome: Source and output PSFs improve paired body metrics; source looks closer at compressed edges. Both fail foreground guards; neither adopted alone.

stages.name: color
stages.comparison: Whole fixed material proposal against the raw primary baseline. Also report colour-only change against its unit-response PSF control.
stages.limits: No fit. Same coefficients/operators across A/B and RGB. Source placement differs from the original expanded output PSF and is not called unchanged full-operator transfer.
stages.stop: First paired strict qualifier on legacy, completed-image, exterior and all ten foreground/artwork guards; no further trials after it.
stages.outcome: First source-PSF + full expanded neutral prior passes every paired legacy/completed/exterior/foreground/artwork guard versus raw and source-PSF-only controls. Visual body progress; dark body/rim remain. No fit or backtrack.

stages.name: outline
stages.question: Can the same actual surface and bounded assumed illumination plausibly supply the missing thin bright rim? Separate transmission tone from reflected radiance.
stages.frozen: Selected source sigma6.75, common gain/bias, geometry, sources/AA/masks/foreground/artwork; no invented HDR or fitted target halo.
stages.outcome: Same-surface Fresnel audit complete; unobserved environment prevents a supported outline image. No outline fidelity acceptance.
